sloka: एषाम् हर्षेण जानामि तर्कश्चापि दृढो मम ।विक्रमेण समानेष्ये सीताम् हत्वा यथा रिपुम् ॥६-२-८॥।।
transliteration: eṣām harṣeṇa jānāmi tarkaścāpi dṛḍho mama ।vikrameṇa samāneṣye sītām hatvā yathā ripum ॥6-2-8॥।।

translations.english: "You ought to work such that we would kill that enemy Ravana of sinful deeds with our prowess and get back Sita. I hope you are capable of doing that."
